description: The bar chart visually compares the execution accuracy of two Text-to-SQL systems—NatSQL (light blue) and TA-SQL (dark blue)—across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, with the horizontal axis representing these task complexity levels and the vertical axis quantifying execution accuracy on a linear scale from 20 to 60, marked at 10-unit intervals. For each category, a pair of adjacent vertical bars displays the respective accuracy scores, with exact values labeled above each bar: in the Simple category, NatSQL achieves 60.21 and TA-SQL 63.14; in Moderate, NatSQL scores 39.64 while TA-SQL reaches 48.60; in Challenging, NatSQL records 32.32 and TA-SQL 36.11; and in the Total category, NatSQL attains 51.35 versus TA-SQL’s 56.19. TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL across all categories, with the largest absolute margin (8.96) occurring in the Moderate category. Although both systems show declining accuracy from Simple to Challenging, TA-SQL maintains a higher performance level throughout, and its total accuracy exceeds NatSQL’s by 4.84 points, reflecting a more robust performance across the evaluated task spectrum.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three task complexity levels: Simple, Moderate, and Challenging, as well as a Total category. The horizontal axis categorizes the task complexity, labeled as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60 in 10-unit intervals. TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL across all categories, with the largest margin observed in the Moderate category, where TA-SQL achieves approximately 52.60 compared to NatSQL's 39.64. In the Challenging category, TA-SQL shows a slight decline to 34.11, while NatSQL remains stable at 32.32. Overall, TA-SQL demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy across complexity levels, culminating in a total accuracy of 58.19, which is significantly higher than NatSQL's 51.35.
